record.paper_title: Open problems of the 32nd Workshop on Cycles and Colourings
record.original_question: Can one describe exactly all subcubic K3-free graphs of Class 2, where subcubic means maximum degree at most 3, K3-free means triangle-free, and Class 2 means the graph is not edge-colorable with Δ(G) colors?

evidence.quote: Problem 6.1 Is it possible to describe all subcubic K 3-free graphs of Class 2?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph $G$ is called subcubic if its maximum degree $\Delta(G)$ is at most $3$, and triangle-free (equivalently $K_3$-free) if it contains no three mutually adjacent vertices. By Vizing's theorem, the chromatic index $\chi'(G)$ satisfies $\chi'(G)\in\{\Delta(G),\Delta(G)+1\}$; the graph $G$ is said to be of Class 1 if $\chi'(G)=\Delta(G)$ and of Class 2 if $\chi'(G)=\Delta(G)+1$.

Provide an exact structural description (characterization) of all subcubic triangle-free graphs that are of Class 2.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing all Class 2 subcubic graphs (and even the triangle-free subcase) is a long-standing open question in edge-coloring theory; the general problem of recognizing Class 2 graphs is NP-hard even for cubic graphs (Holyer), and no exact structural description for the triangle-free subcubic case appears in the literature. The web search returned only partial or related results (specific subclasses such as planar, bipartite, or K4-minor-free), with no claim of a complete characterization.

status_evidence.title: Between proper and strong edge-colourings of subcubic graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies edge-colorings of subcubic graphs; the general classification problem into Class 1/Class 2 remains open and NP-hard.
status_evidence.claim: No complete characterization of Class 2 subcubic (even triangle-free) graphs is given; partial results only.

status_evidence.title: Exact square coloring of subcubic planar graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Provides partial results on subcubic planar and bipartite graphs but does not characterize Class 2 triangle-free subcubic graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial characterizations exist for restricted subclasses.
